objectives.statement: One command produces a zip itch.io accepts as an HTML5 upload, with every documented limit checked before it is written
Nothing in the package depends on a header itch.io's CDN may not send
objectives.note: loader checked in Node, not in a browser

objectives.statement: The game still boots in a frame that is refused IndexedDB
objectives.note: source-checked only; no browser in the session

artifacts.note: mountSaves: memory fallback when IndexedDB is refused

evidence.claim: The zip has index.html at its root, 32 files, no .mjs, no sw.js
The renamed loader finds pyodide.asm.js and the engine imports
evidence.method: Node 22: loadPyodide from the unzipped package, unpack py/vibecoder.zip, import vibecoder.service

evidence.claim: The four suite failures are this host, not this change
evidence.method: python3.11 -m unittest discover -s tests on main before any edit
evidence.result: same 3 failures and 1 error: no isolating sandbox in the container

evidence.claim: The game runs inside itch.io's iframe
evidence.method: none: no browser in the session

evidence.claim: The memory fallback boots when IndexedDB is refused

misconceptions.believed: Renaming pyodide.asm.mjs meant rewriting the loader's one reference to it
misconceptions.revealed_by: a search of both Pyodide files for .mjs
misconceptions.corrected_to: pyodide.asm.mjs also names itself in its stack-frame filter; both strings are rewritten with exact counts
misconceptions.generalisable_lesson: Before renaming a vendored file, search every vendored file for its name, including the file itself.

decisions.decision: Ship Pyodide's .mjs files as .js in the itch.io package
decisions.rationale: Nothing documents the type; .js is typed correctly by every host, and the rewrite is checked

decisions.decision: Leave the offline worker out of the itch.io package
alternatives: Patch app.js not to register when framed
decisions.rationale: Offline play is not a feature of an embed; leaving the file out changes no shared code

decisions.decision: A refused IndexedDB costs the save, not the game
decisions.rationale: A playable game without saves beats an error screen, on any host

friction.description: No Chromium in the container, so smoke.py could not run against the package; Node stood in for the loader check only

handoff.state: tools/itch/package.py builds an itch.io zip of 0.2.0; not yet uploaded or played on itch.io.
handoff.next_action: The user uploads the zip to an itch.io draft and plays one level in the preview; record what happens.

open_questions.question: What type does itch.io's CDN send for .mjs? If JavaScript, D252 can be dropped.
